ACQ_ERA5_Jan1980.description: ERA5 hourly total precipitation and 2 m temperature for January 1980 over the Columbia River Basin.

ENG_Aggregate_Daily.description: Daily-aggregated NetCDF file containing total precipitation (tp) as daily sums and 2 m temperature (t2m) as daily means for January 1980.

INSP_Prototype_Data.description: Map showing the spatial distribution of daily precipitation on January 1, 1980 clipped to the Columbia basin boundary, in EPSG:32611 projection.

EVAL_Plot_Comparison_Prototype.description: Side-by-side map of ERA5 31 km vs. kriged 1 km precipitation for January 1, 1980, with basin boundary overlay.
Side-by-side map of ERA5 31 km vs. kriged 1 km near-surface air temperature for January 1, 1980, with basin boundary overlay.
